# Pagination (`pagination`)

Page buttons with ellipses.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createPagination` (types in `dist/web/navigation/pagination.d.ts`): `nav.mh-pagination` (`--pages | --compact`) > `ul.mh-pagination__list`: `__nav` previous and next buttons (disabled at the ends), `__page` buttons or links (`aria-current="page"` on the current one) and decorative `__ellipsis`; the compact variant shows `__status` ("3 of 12", announced politely) between the arrows instead.

```ts
export function createPagination(options: PaginationOptions): PaginationHandle;

export interface PaginationOptions {
  /** Number of pages (at least 1). */
  count: number;
  /** Current page, 1-based. Default 1. */
  page?: number;
  /** `pages` (default): numbered buttons with ellipses. `compact`: "3 of 12" between the arrows, for small screens. */
  variant?: PaginationVariant;
  /** Pages shown on each side of the current one; default 1. */
  siblings?: number;
  /** Pages always shown at each end; default 1. */
  boundaries?: number;
  /** Accessible name of the navigation; default "Pagination". */
  label?: string;
  /** Renders links instead of buttons (`?page=3`); clicks still call `onChange`. */
  href?: (page: number) => string;
  onChange?: (page: number) => void;
  previousLabel?: string;
  nextLabel?: string;
  /** Accessible name of a page button; default "Page {n}". */
  pageLabel?: (page: number) => string;
}

export interface PaginationHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  page(): number;
  setPage(page: number): void;
  setCount(count: number): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createPagination } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const pagination = createPagination({
  label: 'Event log pages',
  count: 12,
  page: 1,
  onChange: (page) => (status.textContent = `Showing events ${(page - 1) * 20 + 1} to ${page * 20}`),
});

document.body.append(status, pagination.el);
```

## React API

`Pagination` (types in `dist/react/navigation.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createPagination`; controlled through `page` / `onChange`.

```ts

  pageLabel = paginationPageLabel,
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Pagination } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PaginationExample() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  return (
    <div>
      <p>
        Showing events {(page - 1) * 20 + 1} to {page * 20}
      </p>
      <Pagination label="Event log pages" count={12} page={page} onChange={setPage} />
    </div>
  );
}
```
